'''Auaine Fanwar''' is a [[Borderlands|Borderlander]]. She is married to [[Renald Fanwar|Renald]].

==Appearance==
Auaine has premature silver-gray hair, which she keeps in a bun.

==Activities==
After [[Thulin]] leaves their farm and she talks with her husband, she begins packing what they will need on their journey to the war in the north.{{ref/book|12|p}}
